newsitem.title: USA: Developers Diversified sees gain from sale.
newsitem.headline: Developers Diversified sees gain from sale.

text.p: Developers Diversified Realty Corp said Tuesday that it will recognize a gain of more than $3.5 million from the sale of two business centers in Ohio.
The centers, totalling 112,715 square feet, were sold for about $5.7 million to Progressive Casualty Insurance Co, the company said. It said the centers had been vacant for about 18 months.

"This transaction is a very positive event in that it turns two non-income producing assets into substantial cash proceeds which will be immediately re-invested into our core business at strong investment returns," the company said in a release.
